name: kantoku
description: Turn one Claude Code session into a manager (kantoku = 監督) that dispatches tasks to Orca child sessions, triages their questions, verifies their work with a separate verifier, and patrols until done.

showPanelOnStart.title: Show the Manager panel at start
showPanelOnStart.description: Open the kantoku Manager panel beside the chat when a manager session starts. /kantoku-panel show|hide|toggle changes it for one session.
